# The repair table at the summer fair

Set up a small repair table rather than promising a regular service. Most visitors wanted someone to look at an object before deciding whether it was worth fixing. A diagnosis can be useful even if nothing leaves the table repaired. Keep the notes about parts we couldn't source. [[Repair ideas]] should include decisions to stop, not only successful transformations.
